items.description: A parameter: a typed value object, or plain JSON. null binds NULL, true/false bind 1/0, a string binds text, a number without a fraction or exponent binds an integer (it must fit in 64 bits), any other number binds a float. Blobs need the typed form.

oneOf.description: A SQLite value. Integers are decimal strings so all 64 bits survive; floats are numbers, with "Infinity" and "-Infinity" as strings; blobs are standard base64.

additionalProperties.description: A parameter: a typed value object, or plain JSON. null binds NULL, true/false bind 1/0, a string binds text, a number without a fraction or exponent binds an integer (it must fit in 64 bits), any other number binds a float. Blobs need the typed form.

keep_count.description: Scheduled snapshots kept, newest first. 0 keeps any number. Manual snapshots are never removed by retention.

keep_days.description: Scheduled snapshots older than this are removed. 0 keeps any age.
